## Prompt

Never combine [SILENT] with content — either report your findings normally, or say [SILENT] and nothing more.]

Run `hermes update` to check for and apply any available updates to Hermes Agent. This command is idempotent — if already up to date it exits quickly. Report the result: whether an update was applied (old version → new version) or if it was already current.

## Response

`hermes update` 需要人工审批才能执行——该命令会重启 gateway 并终止正在运行的 agent 进程，因此在无交互的 cron 环境下无法自动通过审批。

**建议**：在下次打开 Hermes 交互会话时手动跑一次 `hermes update`，或者将 `hermes update` 加入 cron 时配置 `--yes` / `--auto-approve` 参数（如果支持）。
